title: 第23章 众人大放血第24章 这技能也不行啊
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
很快，秦峰被一名弟子叫到了大殿。
林青河温和道：“秦峰，有一个好消息要告诉你。”
见秦峰没有一点兴奋反应，他尴尬一笑，接着道：“我们决定让你去平南城当城主。”
秦峰道：“就这件事？”
林青河道：“对呀，这不是天大的好事吗，别人想去可还没有机会呢！”
秦峰淡淡道：“哦，不去！”
所有人的笑容都僵在了脸上，穆无双抿嘴一笑，这货果然跟她想的一样。
林青河道：“我说小子，这是六祖亲自点名让你去的，这多好的机会，你为啥不去？”
秦峰道：“别扯犊子，老祖在中域那么远，能关注我一个小小筑基期？”
“肯定是前面有什么危险，想拿我去当炮灰对不对？想都别想，我是不会离开宗门的。”
林青河气愤道：“你这是在质疑我的人品。
我真没骗你。”
看到秦峰依然不为所动，他也急了。
“你知道平南城每年联盟发的资源加上税收有多少钱吗？”
秦峰不屑道：“那能有多少钱？几十万灵石，一百万撑死了。”
林青河轻蔑一笑：“你以为是咱们任务殿呢，我告诉你，至少一千万，如果你经营的好，再立点功，几千万也不是没可能。”
秦峰眼睛一瞪，几千万灵石一年？真是贫穷限制了他的想象力。
他看向了穆无双，穆无双点了点头道：“宗主没有骗你！”
秦峰心里已经开始盘算起来，当个城主，也就是换个地方躺平而已，但资源真多呀。
他晋升筑基期时，已经把所有的灵石都用光了，完美筑基实力强悍，但资源消耗的也巨多。

而且他感觉再升级所需要的资源将呈十倍的往上翻，资源缺口太大了。
如果能当个城主也是不错的，反正对抗魔族都是护卫统领那边，他就躺平就行。
就是前线稍微危险一点，但一个三星城池最强的魔族也就金丹巅峰，对他构不成任何威胁。
他刚要答应，就听到林清河道：“当然了，这么多灵石也不可能都给你。
你留一部分，大部分还是要上交给宗门的。”
秦峰一听这话转身就走，感情说了半天，他就是个打工仔！
他讨厌当打工仔。
林青河急道：“停停停，可以商量的吗？五五分怎么样？”
秦峰依然没有停下他的脚步，往外面走去。
“六四！”
秦峰依然向外走，丝毫不理林青河。
“七三总行了吧，宗门经营一个城，也需要派人维护，还有一些其他费用的！”
见秦峰没有反应，他将求助的目光看向了其他长老，这已经是他能做出最大的让步了。
如果再分的话，那宗门不但没有收益，还要往里搭钱。
四长老道：“只要你愿意去，我再给你加五坛梨花醉。”
秦峰的脚步放缓了一些，其实占七成他也能接受，只是想着还有没有更多好处。
其他长老看到有门儿，疯狂的给四长老使眼色，他心中暗骂，这帮家伙，没一个好东西。
那可是他的心血呀。
最终咬牙道：“十坛梨花醉！”
秦峰这才停下脚步，回头看到四长老一脸肉疼的表情。

有些为难道：“其实我也知道，为宗门效力是应该的，但是我最舍不得的就是师父！”
“她为了培养我们付出了多少的汗水？忍受了多少非议？”
content_en:
Soon, Qin Feng was called to the main hall by a disciple.
Lin Qinghe said gently: "Qin Feng, I have some good news for you."
Seeing that Qin Feng didn't show any excitement, he smiled awkwardly and continued: "We have decided to let you become the city lord of Pingnan City."
Qin Feng said: "That's it?"
Lin Qinghe said: "Yes, isn't this a great thing? Others want to go but they haven't had the chance yet!"
Qin Feng said lightly: "Oh, I won't go!"
Everyone's smiles froze on their faces. Mu Wushuang pursed his lips and smiled. This guy was indeed what she thought.
Lin Qinghe said: "Son, the Sixth Patriarch personally asked you to go. What a great opportunity, why don't you go?"
Qin Feng said: "Don't be ridiculous, my ancestor is so far away in the Central Territory, can he pay attention to me for a small foundation building period?"
"There must be some danger ahead. You want to use me as cannon fodder, right? Don't even think about it. I won't leave the sect."
Lin Qinghe said angrily: "You are questioning my character.
I really didn't lie to you. "
Seeing that Qin Feng was still unmoved, he became anxious.
"Do you know how much resources Pingnan City receives each year from the alliance plus taxes?"
Qin Feng said disdainfully: "How much money can you have? Hundreds of thousands of spirit stones, one million will suffice."
Lin Qinghe smiled contemptuously: "You think it's our mission hall? Let me tell you, it's at least ten million. If you manage well and make some achievements, it's not impossible to get tens of millions."
Qin Feng's eyes widened. Tens of millions of spiritual stones per year? It was poverty that limited his imagination.
He looked at Mu Wushuang, who nodded and said, "The sect master didn't lie to you!"
Qin Feng had already begun to make calculations in his mind. Being a city lord meant just changing his position and lying down, but there were so many resources.
When he advanced to the foundation building stage, he had used up all the spirit stones. The perfect foundation building was powerful, but it also consumed a lot of resources.
Moreover, he felt that the resources required for further upgrades would increase tenfold, and the resource gap was too large.
It would be good if he could be a city lord. Anyway, when fighting against the demons, the guards would be the commanders, so he could just lie down.
The front line is a little more dangerous, but the strongest demon in the three-star city is only at the peak of the Golden Core and cannot pose any threat to him.
Just as he was about to agree, he heard Lin Qinghe say: "Of course, I can't give you all the spiritual stones.
You keep some of it, but most of it has to be handed over to the sect. "
Qin Feng turned around and left as soon as he heard this. After talking about his feelings for a long time, he was just a wage earner!
He hates being a wage earner.
Lin Qinghe said anxiously: "Stop, stop, can we negotiate? How about 50-50?"
Qin Feng still didn't stop and walked outside.
"June 4th!"
Qin Feng still walked out, ignoring Lin Qinghe at all.
"Let's go to Qisan Head Office. If a sect runs a city, it also needs to send people to maintain it, and there are some other expenses!"
Seeing that Qin Feng didn't respond, he looked at the other elders for help. This was the biggest concession he could make.
If it is divided again, the sect will not only have no income, but will also have to spend money.
The fourth elder said: "As long as you are willing to go, I will add five jars of pear blossoms to you."
Qin Feng's pace slowed down a bit. In fact, he could accept 70%, but he was just thinking about whether there would be more benefits.
When the other elders saw Youmener, they winked at the fourth elder crazily. He cursed in his heart, none of these guys were good.
That was his hard work.
Finally, he gritted his teeth and said, "Ten altars of pear blossoms are drunk!"
Qin Feng stopped and turned around to see the pained expression on the fourth elder's face.
Some people are confused: "Actually, I also know that serving the sect is the right thing to do, but the one I hate to part with the most is my master!"
"How much sweat has she put into cultivating us? How much criticism has she endured?"
